annotations.title: Cross-venue perp funding on DEX venues: Hyperliquid vs dYdX, GMX, Lighter, Paradex ranked

description: Use when an agent compares perpetual funding across venues for one coin (carry/crowding). Input: coin (e.g. BTC). Output: JSON venues ranked by annualized funding (DEX venues only: Hyperliquid, dYdX, GMX, Lighter, Paradex), normalized to per-hour and APR, max-min spread with short/long venue, consensus mean, Hyperliquid mark vs oracle and vs dYdX oracle basis. Derived figures only; cached 60 s. Unknown coin: 400, not charged. Use instead: crypto_perp_basis for mark-vs-index premium, OI and carry pairs per venue; crypto_perp_screener for every coin at once; hl_funding_history for funding history over time. Example: ?coin=BTC Price: $0.002 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

coin.description: Hyperliquid perp symbol (BTC, ETH, SOL). Not listed: 400 before payment (not charged); venues that do not list it are reported as unavailable
